method: Read every manifest named by the immutable v2 completion record and count language metadata only. No audio, transcript text, speaker identifier, session identifier or per-row checksum was persisted by this audit.
conclusion: The adopted source corpus cannot satisfy Base-v5 B4 English/French replay or code-switch requirements by resampling. Rights-cleared English, French and real code-switched speech must be adapted into new immutable manifests, split without speaker/session leakage, audited and separately adopted before a Base-v5-compliant training launch.
